verdict.rationale: Google Calendar API documents push notifications for monitoring resource changes, including watch endpoints, plus incremental sync that returns only changed entries. Together these let a system detect event changes. The evidence never shows registrable HTTPS callback URLs, booking-specific payloads, or distinct created/rescheduled/canceled event types, and appointment booking pages are not tied to the push mechanism. missing for 10: documented registrable HTTP callback endpoint details, booking-specific notifications differentiating create/reschedule/cancel, link between appointment booking pages and push notifications, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, webhooks notify my systems in real time when bookings are created, rescheduled, or canceled
